sentences.text: Learned Advocate for the applicant submitted that though this Court refused to grant protection under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 in relation to other three persons.
The materials surfaced during investigation against the applicant, do not connect the applicant with the truck driver or any other accused.
In relation to the other three accused, the material in the form of call recording was available with the investigating agency.
He, therefore submitted that interim relief granted by this Court deserves to be continued as the applicant has not breached the conditions imposed by this Court.
6. Learned APP submitted that since other three accused have been denied protection, the applicant could not have sought protection under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C.
He submits that investigation is completed and charge-sheet has been filed.
2-aba-1508-2023.doc Learned APP, on instructions, states that the applicant has not violated the conditions imposed by this Court.
7. On perusal of the record, it appears that this Court by order dated 23 May 2023 protected the applicant by imposing the conditions referred in the order.
Moreover, the investigation is completed and charge-sheet has been filed.
Prima facie, it appears that absence of materials to connect the applicant with other accused or truck driver was not surfaced during investigation.
Moreover, there are no criminal antecedents to his discredit.

Hence, interim relief granted by this Court dated 23 May 2023 is confirmed subject to same conditions with an additional condition that the applicant shall remain present before the Trial Court during trial on each and every date unless exempted by the Court.

8. The observations made in the order prima facie in nature and the Trial Court shall not be influenced by such observations during trial.
9.
The anticipatory bail application stands disposed of in above terms.

(AMIT BORKAR, J.)
